steps.name: Environment setup and global persistence
steps.description: Validate Node/npm presence and semver requirement from package.json (semver-aware via Node), resolve npm global bin once and atomically create /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh embedding WORKSPACE and NPM_GBIN literals so shells can pick up NODE_ENV and API_ENDPOINT and PATH for future sessions. Back up existing profile snippet with timestamped suffix to avoid collisions. Do not run node/npm at profile load time.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/crm-application-1224-4007/Integration/APIGateway"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node missing" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm missing" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "curl missing" >&2; exit 4; }
# Semver-aware check using node (if package.json present)
if [ -f "$WS/package.json" ]; then
  REQ_NODE=$(node -e "try{const p=require(process.argv[1]);console.log((p.engines&&p.engines.node)||'')}catch(e){process.exit(0)}" "$WS/package.json") || true
  if [ -n "$REQ_NODE" ]; then
    # Node can evaluate semver via a quick JS check without external deps
    node -e "const r=process.argv[1],v=process.argv[2];try{const sem=require('node:child_process'); const rv=require('node:fs').readFileSync('/proc/self/status','utf8');}catch(e){};const s=require('fs');const range=process.argv[1];const ver=process.argv[2];const semver=(v=>{const parts=v.split('.').map(n=>parseInt(n,10)||0);return {major:parts[0],minor:parts[1],patch:parts[2]};});function match(range,ver){try{const semverLib=require('semver');return semverLib.satisfies(ver,range);}catch(e){/* fallback: simple >=major */const m=range.match(/([0-9]+)/);if(!m)return true;return semver(ver).major>=parseInt(m[1],10);} } const installed=process.version.replace(/^v/,''); if(!match(range,installed)){console.error('node version '+installed+' does not satisfy '+range);process.exit(5);}" "$REQ_NODE" "$(node -v | sed 's/^v//')"
  fi
fi
# Resolve npm global bin once and write profile atomically
NPM_GBIN=$(/usr/bin/env npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)
sudo mkdir -p /etc/profile.d
# backup existing safely
if [ -f "$PROFILE" ]; then sudo cp -a "$PROFILE" "$PROFILE.$(date +%s).bak"; fi
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<EOF
# Added by setup: Node env and npm global bin for workspace
# Workspace literal is embedded to allow runtime checks
WORKSPACE="$WS"
NODE_ENV=development
API_ENDPOINT="http://127.0.0.1:5000/api"
# Add deterministic npm global bin resolved at setup time
NPM_GBIN="$NPM_GBIN"
case ":\$PATH:" in
  *":\$NPM_GBIN:") ;;
  *) export PATH="\$NPM_GBIN:\$PATH";;
esac
# Only export NODE_ENV/API_ENDPOINT when working inside the workspace
if [ "${PWD:-}" ] && [[ "${PWD:-}" == "${WORKSPACE}"* ]]; then
  export NODE_ENV
  export API_ENDPOINT
fi
EOF
sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE"
sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
# Source it for current shell session to make tools available to immediate steps (non-login shells may not source it)
# Use sudo to ensure file is readable; source in current shell
. "$PROFILE" || true
# Validate creation
[ -f "$PROFILE" ] || { echo "failed to create $PROFILE" >&2; exit 6; }
node -v | sed -n '1p'
npm -v | sed -n '1p'
exit 0

steps.description: Create a minimal React scaffold in the workspace only if package.json is absent. Detect TypeScript files recursively. Do NOT unconditionally chown -R; only adjust ownership if workspace files are root-owned to avoid mass ownership changes. Create minimal package.json (scripts) and app skeleton; leave deterministic devDependencies to the dependencies step.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/crm-application-1224-4007/Integration/APIGateway" mkdir -p "$WS" && cd "$WS" # Only change ownership when files are root-owned and workspace appears isolated if [ -e "$WS" ]; then ROOT_OWNED=$(find "$WS" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -user root -print -quit || true) if [ -n "$ROOT_OWNED" ]; then ME_UID=$(id -u) || ME_UID=1000; ME_GID=$(id -g) || ME_GID=1000 sudo chown -R "$ME_UID":"$ME_GID" "$WS" fi fi [ -f package.json ] && exit 0 # Detect TypeScript files recursively if find "$WS" -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" \) -print -quit >/dev/null 2>&1; then USE_TS=1; else USE_TS=0; fi # Create minimal package.json (keep dependencies minimal; devDependencies added in dependencies step) if [ "$USE_TS" -eq 1 ]; then cat > package.json <=16"}, "scripts": {"start":"react-scripts start","build":"react-scripts build","test":"npm run test:ci","serve":"serve -s build -l 5000","test:ci":"jest --runInBand --silent"}, "dependencies": {"react":"^18.0.0","react-dom":"^18.0.0","react-scripts":"^5.0.0"} } JSON cat > tsconfig.json <<'JSON' { "compilerOptions": { "target": "ES6", "jsx": "react-jsx", "module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "Node" }, "include": ["src"] } JSON else cat > package.json <=16"}, "scripts": {"start":"react-scripts start","build":"react-scripts build","test":"npm run test:ci","serve":"serve -s build -l 5000","test:ci":"jest --runInBand --silent"}, "dependencies": {"react":"^18.0.0","react-dom":"^18.0.0","react-scripts":"^5.0.0"} } JSON fi mkdir -p src public cat > public/index.html <APIGateway
HTML if [ "$USE_TS" -eq 1 ]; then cat > src/index.tsx <React.createElement('div',null,'APIGateway');createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render(React.createElement(App)); TS else cat > src/index.js <React.createElement('div',null,'APIGateway');createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(React.createElement(App)); JS fi cat > .gitignore < README.md <&2; exit 6; } exit 0

steps.name: Install project dependencies (deterministic, headless)
steps.description: Add missing devDependencies deterministically (serve, jest, typescript if needed), generate package-lock.json (npm i --package-lock-only) after mutation and run npm ci for exact installs. Fail loudly on JSON errors. Validate react-scripts by checking local package.json if --version fails.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/crm-application-1224-4007/Integration/APIGateway"
cd "$WS"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing" >&2; exit 2; }
# Safely mutate package.json with visible errors
node -e '
const fs=require("fs");const P="package.json";let p;try{p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(P));}catch(e){console.error("package.json parse error:",e.message);process.exit(3);}p.devDependencies=p.devDependencies||{};let changed=false;function add(k,v){if(!(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies[k]) && !((p.dependencies||{})[k])){p.devDependencies[k]=v;changed=true}};add("serve","^14.0.0");add("jest","^29.0.0");if(fs.existsSync("tsconfig.json"))add("typescript","^5.0.0");if(changed)fs.writeFileSync(P,JSON.stringify(p,null,2));' || { echo "failed to update package.json" >&2; exit 4; }
# Create package-lock deterministically if absent or outdated
if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then npm i --package-lock-only --no-audit --no-fund --silent; fi
# Deterministic install
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent
# Validate react-scripts presence; be tolerant if --version unsupported
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/react-scripts ]; then
  if ! ./node_modules/.bin/react-scripts --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # fallback: check node_modules/react-scripts/package.json for version
    if [ -f node_modules/react-scripts/package.json ]; then
      jq -r .version node_modules/react-scripts/package.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    else
      echo "react-scripts installed but version check failed" >&2; exit 5
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "react-scripts not installed" >&2; exit 6
fi
exit 0

steps.name: Build, start static server, verify, and stop (validation)
steps.description: Build the React app with npm run build, start project-local serve (node_modules/.bin/serve) on port 5000, verify readiness with retries (longer timeout), capture logs (last 500 lines on failure), and stop process group cleanly using PGID and negative-PGID kill. Portable port check uses ss with netstat fallback.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/crm-application-1224-4007/Integration/APIGateway"
cd "$WS"
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "curl required" >&2; exit 2; }
PORT=5000
# Portable port-in-use check: use ss, fallback to netstat
port_in_use=1
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -E -q ":${PORT}$|:${PORT}\\b"; then port_in_use=0; fi
elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if netstat -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -E -q ":${PORT}$|:${PORT}\\b"; then port_in_use=0; fi
else
  port_in_use=1
fi
if [ "$port_in_use" -eq 0 ]; then echo "port $PORT already in use" >&2; exit 3; fi
# Build
npm run build --silent || { echo "build failed" >&2; exit 4; }
SERVE_BIN="$WS/node_modules/.bin/serve"
if [ ! -x "$SERVE_BIN" ]; then echo "serve binary not found" >&2; exit 5; fi
LOG=/tmp/serve_integration.log
# Start serve in background and capture PID and PGID
setsid "$SERVE_BIN" -s build -l "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# Allow process table to populate
sleep 1
if ! kill -0 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "serve process not running, logs:" >&2; tail -n 500 "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 6; fi
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= "$PID" | tr -d ' ')
if [ -z "$PGID" ]; then PGID=$PID; fi
# Ensure cleanup uses negative PGID for group kill
trap 'kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
# Wait up to 60s for HTTP 200 with 1s intervals
OK=1
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ || echo 000)
  if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then OK=0; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ $OK -ne 0 ]; then echo "server failed to respond, last status=$STATUS" >&2; tail -n 500 "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 7; fi
# Evidence
echo "BUILD_DIR=$WS/build"
echo "HTTP_STATUS=$STATUS"
# Clean shutdown via trap
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/crm-application-1224-4007/Integration/APIGateway"
cd "$WS"
PORT=5000
LOG=/tmp/serve_integration.log
# Check for curl (used by validation later) and for serve binary
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "curl required" >&2; exit 2; }
SERVE_BIN="$WS/node_modules/.bin/serve"
[ -x "$SERVE_BIN" ] || { echo "serve binary not found at $SERVE_BIN" >&2; exit 5; }
# Portable port-in-use check: ss then netstat
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ss -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -E -q ":${PORT}$|:${PORT}\\b"; then echo "port $PORT already in use" >&2; exit 3; fi
elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if netstat -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -E -q ":${PORT}$|:${PORT}\\b"; then echo "port $PORT already in use" >&2; exit 3; fi
fi
# Start serve in new session so we can kill group; capture PID and PGID
setsid "$SERVE_BIN" -s build -l "$PORT" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 1
if ! kill -0 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "serve process not running, logs:" >&2; tail -n 500 "$LOG" >&2 || true; exit 6; fi
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= "$PID" | tr -d ' ')
[ -z "$PGID" ] && PGID=$PID
# Save PGID/PID to files for stop script
echo "$PID" > /tmp/serve_integration.pid
echo "$PGID" > /tmp/serve_integration.pgid
echo "$LOG" > /tmp/serve_integration.logpath
# Install trap for interactive runs; start script exits but leaves files for stop
trap 'kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
# Print start info
echo "SERVE_STARTED PID=$PID PGID=$PGID LOG=$LOG"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/crm-application-1224-4007/Integration/APIGateway"
cd "$WS"
PORT=5000
LOG_FILE=${LOG_FILE:-/tmp/serve_integration.log}
PID_FILE=/tmp/serve_integration.pid
PGID_FILE=/tmp/serve_integration.pgid
# Ensure curl available
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "curl required" >&2; exit 2; }
# Ensure server process info exists
[ -f "$PID_FILE" ] || { echo "PID file not found: $PID_FILE" >&2; exit 8; }
PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")
[ -n "$PID" ] || { echo "invalid PID" >&2; exit 8; }
# Wait up to 120s for HTTP 200 with 1s intervals (longer timeout)
OK=1
STATUS=000
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/ || echo 000)
  if [ "$STATUS" = "200" ]; then OK=0; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ $OK -ne 0 ]; then echo "server failed to respond, last status=$STATUS" >&2; tail -n 500 "$LOG_FILE" >&2 || true; exit 7; fi
echo "HTTP_STATUS=$STATUS"
# Provide build dir evidence if present
[ -d "$WS/build" ] && echo "BUILD_DIR=$WS/build"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PID_FILE=/tmp/serve_integration.pid
PGID_FILE=/tmp/serve_integration.pgid
LOG_PATH_FILE=/tmp/serve_integration.logpath
[ -f "$PID_FILE" ] || { echo "no PID file, nothing to stop"; exit 0; }
PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
PGID=$(cat "$PGID_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
LOG=$(cat "$LOG_PATH_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
# Prefer group kill if PGID present
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then
  kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
  [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# Wait up to 10s for process to exit
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then sleep 1; else break; fi
done
# Forceful kill if still alive
if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  else kill -KILL "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi
# Print final logs path if exists
[ -n "$LOG" ] && echo "LOG=$LOG"
# Cleanup files
rm -f "$PID_FILE" "$PGID_FILE" "$LOG_PATH_FILE" || true
exit 0
